description: This Kotlin source file implements motion activity and pedometer handling for Android using sensor data. It includes data classes for requests and records, a data source interface with a system implementation, and a MotionHandler class managing motion detection and permission checks.

classes.name: MotionActivityRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for motion activity data, with optional start and end ISO timestamps and a limit.

classes.name: MotionPedometerRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for pedometer data, with optional start and end ISO timestamps.

classes.name: MotionActivityRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a recorded motion activity, including timestamps, confidence, and activity type flags.

classes.name: PedometerRecord
classes.description: Data class representing pedometer data, including steps, distance, and floors climbed/descended.

classes.name: MotionDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check feature availability, permissions, and to fetch activity and pedometer data.

classes.name: SystemMotionDataSource
classes.description: System implementation of MotionDataSource using Android sensors, with methods to detect feature presence and retrieve sensor data for activity classification and step counting.

classes.name: MotionHandler
classes.description: Main class that handles motion activity and pedometer requests, checks permissions, invokes data source methods, and formats results into JSON.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if accelerometer is available on device.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if step counter sensor is available.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if app has ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION permission.

methods.name: activity
methods.description: Reads accelerometer data for 2 seconds to classify user activity (walking, running, stationary).

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Reads step counter sensor data to estimate steps taken.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity
methods.description: Handles motion activity requests, checks permissions, invokes data source, and returns JSON results.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer
methods.description: Handles pedometer requests, checks permissions, invokes data source, and returns JSON results.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if any motion capability is available.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if activity sensing capability is available.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if pedometer sensing is available.
